title: Minerals-deal attestation (UMA whale-resolution adaptation)
rationale: AC-1 requires a signed-instrument citation (SIGNED_INSTRUMENT_REF line) for an EXECUTED: YES conclusion. The delivered report cites only a press communiqué and an initialled, expressly non-binding MOU — AC-1 fails deterministically and the registry evidence shows no executed agreement by the deadline.
historicalDivergence: Adapted from the March 2025 UMA/Polymarket "Ukraine minerals deal" resolution (~$7M open interest), where a holder of concentrated oracle voting power pushed a YES resolution although no agreement had been executed by the market deadline. Groundtruth here is the evidence-supported outcome (no executed instrument), NOT the manipulated historical resolution.
